colecoes.descricao_html: Comfort, sun protection and dry organization for relaxed days by the water.
Compact tools that keep an easy weekend camp organized and welcoming.

produtos.descricao_html:
A compact crossbody that keeps phone, keys, license and small tackle together when the shoreline gets wet.

  • Hands-free carry for bank, pier and boat
  • Quick-access compartments without bulky tackle-box weight
  • Wipe-clean shell and adjustable strap

Use it as the dry center of your first fishing setup.
produtos.seo_titulo: Waterproof Fishing Crossbody for Women | SheCurrent
produtos.seo_descricao: Keep phone, keys and small tackle dry in a compact hands-free fishing crossbody by SheCurrent Outdoors.

pdp.eyebrow: Your dry zone by the water
pdp.lede: Everything important stays close, organized and out of the splash.

produtos.descricao_html:
Light fingerless gloves for sun coverage without giving up knot-tying dexterity.

  • Open fingertips for line and lure control
  • Breathable coverage for long bright sessions
  • Low-bulk shape that stores in any pouch

Built for comfort, not armor.
produtos.seo_titulo: Fingerless Sun Fishing Gloves for Women | SheCurrent
produtos.seo_descricao: Breathable fingerless fishing gloves for sun coverage and easy line handling.

pdp.lede: Tie, cast and handle your gear while keeping the backs of your hands covered.

produtos.descricao_html:
A soft, packable gaiter for the moments when the sun, wind or glare gets uncomfortable.

  • Wear around the neck or pull up over the lower face
  • Lightweight fabric dries quickly
  • Fits inside the TideSafe Crossbody

An easy layer that replaces repeated fuss with sunscreen on the go.
produtos.seo_titulo: Cooling Fishing Neck Gaiter for Women | SheCurrent
produtos.seo_descricao: A lightweight fishing gaiter for comfortable sun and wind coverage by the water.

pdp.eyebrow: A cooler layer for bright days
pdp.lede: Pull it up when the glare builds, then pack it away in seconds.

produtos.descricao_html:
A clear waterproof pouch that separates the phone from wet hands, bait and camp clutter.

  • Touch-friendly window for quick checks
  • Neck cord for hands-free carry
  • Compact backup layer inside a larger bag

Test the seal before every trip and avoid full submersion.
produtos.seo_titulo: Waterproof Phone Pouch for Fishing and Camping
produtos.seo_descricao: Keep your phone separated from splash and camp mess with the SheCurrent DryPocket.

pdp.eyebrow: A simple second layer of protection
pdp.lede: Keep the phone visible, reachable and away from splash.

produtos.descricao_html:
A fold-flat organizer that turns tent and campsite clutter into visible pockets.

  • Hang from a tent loop, chair or shelter rail
  • Separate light, toiletries, keys and small tools
  • Folds down for weekend packing

Less searching after dark, more time settling in.
produtos.seo_titulo: Hanging Camping Organizer for Women | SheCurrent
produtos.seo_descricao: A compact fold-flat hanging organizer for an easier, less cluttered campsite.

pdp.lede: Stop digging through a dark tent for the small thing you need right now.

sequencia.prompt:
ROLE: You are the senior art director for a premium American outdoor e-commerce launch. Produce one original, commercially usable photograph for SheCurrent Outdoors.

OBJECTIVE: Create a conversion-focused campaign banner with a deliberately protected copy-safe area and a calm, credible outdoor setting.

PRODUCT FIDELITY: Use the supplied competitor references only for composition, never for logos, people or products.

COMPETITOR REFERENCE: Attach the product-folder reference images named modelo-pagina-concorrente and produto-referencia. Use them only to study shot hierarchy, merchandising clarity and functional context. Do not reproduce their people, compositions, logos, packaging, products, copy, colourways or distinctive layouts.

CAST AND WORLD: Feature a 32 to 48 year old American casual angler or beginner camper, competent and relaxed rather than athletic or fashion-editorial. The visual world is deep evergreen #163D3A, warm ivory #F5F2E9, soft sage #E6EBDD and restrained coral #E57845, expressed through real wardrobe and props rather than colour grading.

ART DIRECTION: Mulher preparando uma pescaria tranquila na margem de um lago, com o kit visível e área livre para copy. Use natural early-morning or late-afternoon light, true-to-life material texture, realistic scale, clean visual hierarchy and a calm premium retail finish. Preserve a clear subject, uncluttered background and intentional negative space when copy may be added later.

QUALITY BAR: High-end commercial photography, correct anatomy and hands, physically plausible shadows, no artificial skin, no duplicated items, no accidental logos, no generated lettering, no fake badges, no watermarks and no AI artefacts.

DELIVERY: Horizontal 16:9, 1920 x 1080 px.
